title: Publish shipping stems and port access terms (bulk wheat port terminals)
what: Port terminal service providers for bulk wheat must publish a shipping stem report on their website each business day.

laws.title: Competition and Consumer (Industry Code—Bulk Wheat) Regulations 2026

sources.title: Competition and Consumer (Industry Code—Bulk Wheat) Regulations 2026
sources.quote: 10 Port terminal service provider to make available shipping stem reports (1) A port terminal service provider must on each business day make available to the public on its website a report that lists each ship scheduled to be loaded with grain through the use of a port terminal service provided at a port terminal facility that the provider owns (whether alone or jointly) or operates (whether alone or jointly).

reach.condition: if it provides port terminal services for bulk wheat

assessment.summary: Port terminal service providers for bulk wheat must make available shipping stem reports, their demand management policies, and standard terms and reference prices.

marks.reason: Transparent access terms help exporters use terminals owned by rivals.
